notes:
Main text occupies approximately 23 physical lines, with raised additions; the upper cancelled note has about six oblique lines and the lower live note about seven. The authorial number 17 is at the top and thin foliation 34 at bottom left. The page continues a discussion of the inverse image of x in the universal abelian covering and asserts triviality only for x=0; it then discusses characteristic p, radicial parts and the proétale quotient. It says the prime-to-p fundamental-group formulation has a counterexample already for an elliptic curve, made anabelian by removing points. These full geometric claims are reported from the page; they are not independently proved here. A limited algebraic check by the main reader is given below. Main corrections against C are rév. with visible accent, G(n) simeq G, a locally doubtful des|de, four resolved supplied doubts, and improved reading/punctuation of the lower note. H has substantial word omissions and relocates multiple insertions. The H subscript has a joined arch that by itself admits n: H_1 is the witnesses’ and established notation reading reported by the main reader; both survive as 1|n in the page. The blind crop separates the paired closing quotes after raised texte from its long leader; no unseen opening quote is supplied. Uncertain cancelled letters, the lower note abbreviation stop, au cas and l’aise/l’air remain marked. The lower note’s en se remplaçant is retained despite awkward grammar; no algebraic correction or missing word is supplied. Initial and repeated quotations use literal paired double marks. No OCR, external research, other-page witness/image inspection or TeX compilation was used. The main reader added an extra blind-reading box for the tiny initial accent, despite the first reading being high confidence. Main-reader mathematical check (149_scan035_prime_to_p_divisibility): if x in a commutative group is killed by p^r and n is prime to p, choose integers m,t with mn=1+t p^r. Then n(mx)=x. Applied to field-valued points, the chosen preimage mx is still rational over the same field. Such p-primary torsion points therefore have zero Kummer boundary for each prime-to-p multiplication map whenever that boundary is defined. This checks the elementary divisibility obstruction underlying the discussion; it does not verify the complete geometric counterexample or the preceding theorem.

[Blind audit] The cancelled phrase now reads je pense qu’il, locally doubtful, and the next cancelled fragment qu’il en has quitte as an alternative. The preposition after proétale favours du over de, with both retained. The compact relèvts form is retained as primary with relèvements alternative. The inserted word sur has no visible accent; the accented rév. at the head is independently confirmed. Les before prouver and des pts at the foot replace the singular forms supplied by C (the former also by H). The short diagonal through la before validité is confirmed as a cancellation. The upper cancelled note remains very insecure and no guessed expansion replaces its lacunae. In the lower note the dark strokes around au cas remain retracing/overlap rather than a securely readable deleted word; the extra où-il/qui-est proposed by the blind reader lies in the neighbouring main-text intrusion into this slanted rectangular crop, not in the note. Se at the opening remains live, parfait is underlined and the three final dots remain distinct. No new mathematical check was made.
